title: Cosmic Eye of Creation
description: A massive green alien eye with intricate iris patterns dominates the center of a surreal cosmic landscape. An alien grey head emerges from swirling purple and gold nebulae above, while the lower half of the eye transitions into an underwater scene with glowing aquatic plants, coral silhouettes, and a twilight mountain horizon.
